items.description: Strategically located in Malad East, Saroj Sadan CHS Ltd. is a thoughtfully planned residential redevelopment project designed to enhance urban living. Surrounded by established infrastructure and key lifestyle conveniences, it offers residents the advantage of a well-connected address.

Experience elevated living at Rose Blossom, where serene green surroundings meet exceptional urban connectivity in Jogeshwari (E). A perfect blend of comfort, lifestyle, and connectivity crafted for contemporary city living.

Located in the heart of Nehru Nagar, Kurla East, OM Nandadeep CHS represents a new benchmark in modern urban living. As the first self-redevelopment project in Kurla East, it combines thoughtful design, contemporary comforts, and a strong community-centric vision.

Experience modern living at GurukulHeights, Vikhroli (E), thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience. Enjoy excellent connectivity, everyday essentials nearby, and a well-connected neighbourhood that complements your lifestyle.

Nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of J.B. Nagar, Andheri East, Green Shadows offers a perfect balance between city life and everyday tranquility. Designed for modern families, the project provides well-planned residences in a location known for excellent connectivity and essential conveniences.
